# generated/coverletter — auto-generated cover letters

The automaton writes per-application cover letters here (a `.pdf` for upload
fields plus a `.txt`, named `cover-<company>-<timestamp>.{pdf,txt}`) when
cover-letter generation is enabled. The letter text also auto-fills inline
cover-letter textareas. Files are **git-ignored** (may contain personal data);
this folder and README are kept so a fresh clone has the structure.

See `docs/configuration.md` and `linkedin_easy_apply/orchestrator.py`
(`_COVER_DIR`) for where this path is wired.
